translations.en.yusufali: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
translations.id.indonesian: Demi kuda perang yang berlari kencang dengan terengah-engah,

translations.en.sahih: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
translations.id.indonesian: dan kuda yang mencetuskan api dengan pukulan (kuku kakinya),

translations.en.pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
translations.en.yusufali: And push home the charge in the morning,
translations.id.indonesian: dan kuda yang menyerang dengan tiba-tiba di waktu pagi,

translations.en.pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
translations.en.yusufali: And raise the dust in clouds the while,

translations.en.sahih: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
translations.en.pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
translations.en.yusufali: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan menyerbu ke tengah-tengah kumpulan musuh,

translations.en.sahih: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
translations.en.yusufali: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya manusia itu sangat ingkar, tidak berterima kasih kepada Tuhannya,

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
translations.en.yusufali: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya manusia itu menyaksikan (sendiri) keingkarannya,

transliteration: Wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed

translations.en.sahih: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
translations.en.yusufali: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya dia sangat bakhil karena cintanya kepada harta.

arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
transliteration: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor

translations.en.sahih: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
translations.en.pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
translations.en.yusufali: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah dia tidak mengetahui apabila dibangkitkan apa yang ada di dalam kubur,

translations.en.sahih: And that within the breasts is obtained,
translations.en.pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
translations.en.yusufali: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
translations.id.indonesian: dan dilahirkan apa yang ada di dalam dada,

transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
translations.en.pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
translations.en.yusufali: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya Tuhan mereka pada hari itu Maha Mengetahui keadaan mereka.
